answer: Locks are written down in velvet, expire in mirror, and canyon lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 13 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 172 aliases hence needs 86 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4285 identities would post 2934 proofs and burn roughly 84 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
